evidence: artist_matching_task is enqueued only after embedding_task succeeds (:68, after the telemetry block that re-raises), so an embedding-model failure stops all matching for the playlist. No backend query reads a vector: no <=>/<->/<#> operator anywhere; the only embedding SQL is IS NULL selects and UPDATEs (broadcast_artists.py:96/117, broadcast_track_identities.py:102/131). HNSW indexes exist (0005_vector_indexes.sql:11-23). Session C grep confirmed.
recommended_change: Pending open question 2 (are vectors planned to be read?): make embedding a side branch. ingestion_task enqueues embedding_task and artist_matching_task as two enqueue_or_log hand-offs; delete the :68 enqueue.

evidence: The worker reads PENDING artists with no lock (:86), calls MusicBrainz at 1.1 s per lookup, then writes with a blind UPDATE ... WHERE id = %s (:109-111) and commits at artist_matching_tasks.py:97. resolve_artist (API process) sets MANUAL_MATCHED with no prior-status guard (routers/matching.py:638). Procfile -w 1 does not serialise the API against the worker. A manual match made mid-run is overwritten. Whether the UI offers PENDING artists for review: NOT MEASURED (matching.py:205-232).
recommended_change: Guard the worker-side status UPDATE with AND match_status = 'pending' and skip matches.create when rowcount is 0, so a manual decision wins (proposed AUD-R018).

evidence: Unguarded task-to-task hand-off artist_matching_task -> identity_matching_task, outside backend.tasks._enqueue_chain.enqueue_or_log; breaches AUD-R014 (ACTIVE). Artist results are already committed (:97), so nothing is corrupted. An enqueue error reaches only Huey's log, with no SystemLog, and identities stay PENDING until the next run or resolve.
recommended_change: Replace the bare call with enqueue_or_log(identity_matching_task, ...).

evidence: Unguarded task-to-task hand-off embedding_task -> artist_matching_task; breaches AUD-R014 (ACTIVE). Superseded in substance if AUD-059 removes this hand-off.
recommended_change: Fix with AUD-059 (move the hand-off to ingestion_task via enqueue_or_log), or at minimum wrap :68 in enqueue_or_log.

evidence: Unguarded periodic-to-task hand-off library_watcher_poll -> library_scan_files_task; breaches AUD-R014 (ACTIVE). Hashes are staged and committed (:89-90) before the enqueue. If it raises, the folders count as in flight until the 1 h STAGED_HASH_TTL (:44, :54), so changes are delayed up to about 64 min and no SystemLog is written. enqueue_or_log is already imported (:34).
recommended_change: Wrap :102 in enqueue_or_log and, on failure, clear_staged_hashes(task_id) so the next 4-minute tick retries.

evidence: library_scan_files_task is the fattest task (260 body lines, EV08). Envelope is about 190 lines: connections 108-131, advisory lock 133-145, RUNNING/started 147-172, per-folder progress 230-258, COMPLETED 269-305, enqueue 307-323, except/finally 325-366. Business logic is about 62 lines inside the task: scan 174-181, grouping 183-228, reconcile and commit 260-267.
recommended_change: Move 174-267 into one service function (e.g. scan_changed_folders(folder_paths, repos, conn, on_folder_done) -> files_written); the task keeps only the envelope.

evidence: Both consumers run -w 1 (Procfile:2 huey, :3 cue_huey). Duplicate-delivery safety of library_enrichment_task, mb_enrichment_task, the hash backfill and matching rests on it. No lock_task, advisory lock or SKIP LOCKED exists on those tasks. The MB rate limiter is a process-local threading.Lock (mb_client.py:24-43). backfill_is_live is check-then-act (library_hash_backfill_tasks.py:98-103, 119-121). None of this is documented as a constraint.
recommended_change: Record -w 1 as a constraint (proposed AUD-R017) in the Procfile comment and the tasks package docstring. Add run exclusion only if a worker count above 1 is ever wanted.

evidence: Five sites cite AUD-R011 ('decision 1') for hand-off ownership: _enqueue_chain.py:9, ingestion_tasks.py:351, library_enrichment_tasks.py:234, library_scan_tasks.py:531, library_watcher_tasks.py:307. In the ledger, AUD-R011 rules envelope sharing (task_run for the enrichment pair only) and has no numbered decisions. The hand-off rule is AUD-R012 (1).
recommended_change: Change the five citations to 'AUD-R012 (1)', and AUD-R014 where the comment generalises to every hand-off.

evidence: update_recording_link is a blind UPDATE ... WHERE id = %s (:289-291) with no enrichment_status = 'pending' guard. It is safe today only because -w 1 serialises enrichment against scan/watcher. With more workers, a late enrichment run could overwrite a row that a rescan had reset to pending.
recommended_change: Add AND enrichment_status = 'pending' and check rowcount (proposed AUD-R018).

evidence: The progress poll (0.5 s per connection, :25, :61, :104) also writes. Every tick runs STALE_SQL (:28-31, :64-65), marking RUNNING rows older than 10 min as failed and committing. So reaping happens only while a /ws client is connected, and N tabs means N reapers. The poll itself is fine at this scale; the write in the read path is the defect (CQRS).
recommended_change: Move the stale reaper into a Huey periodic task; the /ws loop becomes a pure read.

evidence: normalize_backfill_task has no producer: no ENQUEUE or INLINE in backend/scripts, and only tests call it (call_local). It was a one-shot backfill after migration 0011 (:1-4), and vulture flags it (audit/vulture.txt:108). Its payload is db_url, a full DSN, so a password would sit in the SQLite queue file if it were ever enqueued.
recommended_change: Delete the task and its test (after confirming the scan fills normalized_artist_name), or move it to scripts/ as a one-off that reads settings.database_url.

evidence: Nothing prevents duplicate full scans. The router enqueues unconditionally (:39), and library_scan_task writes a fresh RUNNING row with no running-scan check (library_scan_tasks.py:429-465). A double-clicked POST queues a second disk-bound rescan. The upsert keeps data idempotent, so the cost is time.
recommended_change: Return 409 from the router when task_progress holds a live RUNNING SCAN row (one service call), or skip in the task.

evidence: An unhashable row keeps count_audio_unhashed() above zero forever (comments :136-141, :148-152). So every 5 minutes the resume periodic (:180) starts a full keyset walk that re-reads those files. Log noise is suppressed; the disk reads are not. The periodic itself is the right design (it reconciles watcher, crash and failed-enqueue paths).
recommended_change: Record size/mtime of a failed hash attempt and exclude unchanged rows from count/get_audio_unhashed.

evidence: ingestion_task: 247 body lines, of which about 8 are business logic (count_csv_rows :241, _run_ingest :303-309). Parsing, dedup and inserts already live in ingest_csv (ingestion_service.py:205-250). About 239 lines are a hand-rolled envelope: connection, RUNNING upsert, SystemLogs, row callback, COMPLETED, enqueue, except/finally. AUD-R011 keeps this envelope distinct from task_run.
recommended_change: No logic to move. Envelope consolidation needs AUD-R011 revisited first (the trail notes Lance closed that program); leave as is unless Lance reopens it.

evidence: The full upload, up to 50 MB (MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE :15), is pickled into the SqliteHuey queue row as file_bytes and held in worker memory. Duplicates are harmless (sha256 dedup ingestion_service.py:245-250, per-station advisory lock ingestion_tasks.py:187). The cost is queue-file bloat while the worker is down.
recommended_change: Optional claim-check (write to a data dir, pass path + sha256). Only if large uploads or worker downtime prove real.

evidence: library_enrichment_task (190 body lines): envelope about 105 lines, business logic about 65 (repos, chunks, three pass loops). The try/commit/rollback/warn/report_running block is repeated across the three passes (about 45 duplicated lines: :153-160, :179-186, :205-212 plus their handlers).

evidence: The watcher's grouping loop mirrors library_scan_tasks.py's: both call assign_work and catch (psycopg.Error, ValueError, OSError) at watcher :202/:222 and scan :376/:402, and both group files with no work_id, so they change for the same reason. AUD-053 noted this as out of scope (count only).

evidence: stream_cue_analysis_task is a @cue_huey.task, but its only caller is stream_cue_analysis_resume's call_local() (:258). No backend code enqueues it, so the decorator registers a queue task that never travels the queue. Same shape as library_hash_backfill_resume, except the backfill is also enqueued by the scan (:545).

evidence: retry_enrichment opens a connection, builds a concrete PgLibraryFileRepository (:121-124), resets failed -> pending, commits, and enqueues (:131): two actions plus adapter wiring in a router, against .claude/rules/architecture-boundaries.md. The hand-off itself is sound (reset committed before enqueue).

evidence: progress_tracking gates behaviour here: run_hash_backfill refuses to start (:119-121) when a RUNNING HASH_BACKFILL row is younger than LIVENESS_WINDOW = 10 min (:36). That window is kept in step by hand with websocket STALE_THRESHOLD_MINUTES (comment :34-35).

evidence: The watcher's run lock is pg_try_advisory_lock(hashtext(folder_paths[0])): it is keyed on the first folder only, and full scans in library_scan_tasks.py take no lock. Whether a full scan and a watcher scan of the same folders can write concurrently was not traced. Under -w 1 they run serially in one consumer, so the question only matters with more workers.
recommended_change: Needs about 2 windows: library_scan_tasks.py run start and _run_scan's write path. Moot while AUD-R017 (-w 1) holds.
